roster.name: builder
roster.description: Implements one task with the minimum diff, keeps the existing tests green, and stops at the stated bound. Refuses to widen scope.

roster.name: scout
roster.description: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — locates code across many files and returns only the conclusion.

roster.name: planner
roster.description: Turns a backlog item into a task — writes the acceptance test and the file list before any code is written. Refuses to edit code.

roster.name: verifier
roster.description: Pre-commit audit specialist. Reads the staged diff and reviews it against the repo standards; returns findings in tiers.

roster.name: scribe
roster.description: Records the tick — writes one status line per run, updates the gate log, and publishes the progress dashboard. Never changes code.

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build a feature or fix a bug test-first.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Reviews a branch or work-in-progress changes for bugs and standards. Use when the user asks for a review.

skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Writes release notes from the commits since the last tag. Use when the user is cutting a release.
